title: STEELBIRD SBA 20 - 09 BT
description:
Steelbird SBA 20-09 BT Smart Flip-Up Helmet

Smart Connectivity. Superior Protection. Everyday Versatility.

The Steelbird SBA 20-09 BT Helmet is a next-generation smart modular helmet designed for riders who demand the perfect combination of safety, convenience, and connectivity. Featuring integrated Bluetooth 5.2 technology, a flip-up modular design, and advanced rider comfort features, the SBA 20-09 BT is ideal for daily commuting, touring, and long-distance rides.

Built with a high-impact thermoplastic ABS shell, the helmet delivers reliable protection while maintaining a lightweight and comfortable feel. The aerodynamic shell design improves stability at higher speeds by reducing wind resistance, while the sporty rear spoiler enhances both performance and style.

Its integrated Bluetooth 5.2 system allows riders to enjoy hands-free calling, GPS navigation prompts, music streaming, and voice command support without taking their focus off the road. With up to 48 hours of talk time and approximately 110 hours of standby time, the helmet is built to keep you connected on every journey. 

The modular flip-up mechanism offers the flexibility of both an open-face and full-face helmet, making it ideal for city traffic as well as highway touring. An integrated inner sun visor provides instant protection from glare, while the anti-scratch outer visor ensures clear visibility in varying riding conditions. 

Comfort is enhanced through a dynamic multi-vent ventilation system, breathable interior padding, and removable, washable liners that keep the helmet fresh during extended rides. The secure micrometric quick-release buckle ensures easy operation while providing a reliable fit every time. 

Key Features

Shell Construction

  • High-impact ABS thermoplastic shell.

  • Aerodynamic design for improved stability.

  • Sporty rear spoiler for enhanced performance and styling.

  • Lightweight construction for everyday comfort.

Smart Bluetooth Features

  • Built-in Bluetooth 5.2 connectivity.

  • Hands-free calling and music streaming.

  • GPS navigation audio support.

  • Voice command compatibility.

  • LED status indicator.

  • Up to 48 hours talk time and 110 hours standby time. 

Safety

  • ISI certified for Indian road use.

  • High-density EPS liner for effective impact absorption.

  • Secure micrometric quick-release buckle.

  • Reliable modular locking mechanism. 

Visor System

  • Anti-scratch outer visor.

  • Integrated inner smoke sun visor.

  • Wide field of vision for enhanced road awareness.

Ventilation

  • Dynamic multi-vent airflow system.

  • Efficient cooling for long rides.

  • Breathable interior with enhanced airflow channels.

Interior Comfort

  • Removable and washable liners.

  • Soft breathable padding with neck protector.

  • Comfortable fit for extended touring and commuting.

Why Choose the Steelbird SBA 20-09 BT?

The Steelbird SBA 20-09 BT combines smart Bluetooth connectivity, modular convenience, dependable protection, and rider-focused comfort into one versatile helmet. Whether you're navigating city traffic, touring across highways, or riding daily, it keeps you connected, comfortable, and protected throughout every journey.

Ideal For

  • Daily commuting

  • Highway touring

  • Urban riding

  • Long-distance travel

  • Riders seeking integrated Bluetooth functionality

Important Notes

  • Always ensure proper fit and secure fastening before riding.

  • Charge the Bluetooth system fully before extended rides.

  • Product colours, graphics, and specifications may vary depending on the selected variant.

title: SBA-20 Painted Glossy Black
description:
Steelbird has announced the SBA-20 flip-up helmet, which the company claims is lightweight, stylish, comfortable and provides superior protection to riders.

At the heart of the SBA-20 Helmet is its thermoplastic shell, engineered to provide the best possible protection to riders while maintaining a lightweight design. Riders can now say goodbye to sweaty, uncomfortable helmets.

The SBA-20 Helmet features a dynamic airflow ventilation system that regulates temperature, keeping the riders cool and comfortable throughout the journey.

“Safety is our top priority. The SBA-20 Helmet incorporates high-density EPS (Expanded Polystyrene) to absorb and disperse impact energy, minimizing the risk of head injuries in the event of an accident. Safety doesn’t end when the sun goes down. The SBA-20 Helmet features a reflective part around the neck area, significantly improving visibility during night rides, and making every journey safer
